'''Adem Antin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the son of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Amie Antin]], a member of [[the Eleven]]. He lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]], in the town of [[Ussa]]. In [[19 BBY]] he was ten and would walk himself to school. The [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]], [[Malorum]] threatened Adem Antin when speaking with his mother Amie Antin. Amie however, held her ground and told Malorum he was a coward for threatening her son. The threat was enough to sway Amie to join the Eleven.<ref name="LOTJTDM" /> After she joined the Eleven she sorely missed her son.<ref name="LOTJMOD">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception]]''</ref>
